**STR** 16 (+3) | **DEX** 12 (+1) | **CON** 12 (+1) | **INT** 9 (-1) | **WIS** 8 (-1) | **CHA** 6 (-2)
**Skills:** [Skill: Athletics](../proficiencies/skill-athletics.md) +5, [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +3, [Skill: Stealth](../proficiencies/skill-stealth.md) +5
**Senses:** Blindsight 30 ft., Passive Perception 13
